name: saga-tic-tac-toe-example
description: A tic-tac-toe game for an assistant conversation, generated with saga init (react-mcp on Hono): a React board served as an MCP App, and one play_move operation for the person's clicks and the assistant's tool calls. It is not part of the npm workspace: scripts/build-tic-tac-toe.ts installs the packed SDK packages into a clean copy of it and builds that.

scripts.build: npm run build:view && npm run build:server
